final: WITH equipment_avgs AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), reference_avgs AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS all_avg FROM equipment_avgs), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, e.avg_humidity - r.all_avg AS excess_over_all_equipment_avg FROM equipment_avgs e CROSS JOIN reference_avgs r WHERE e.avg_humidity > r.all_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity FROM kept), ranked AS (SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_humidity, k.excess_over_all_equipment_avg, k.avg_humidity - m.mean_humidity AS difference_from_kept_mean, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY k.avg_humidity - m.mean_humidity DESC NULLS LAST) AS result_rank FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE (SELECT all_avg FROM reference_avgs) IS NOT NULL AND m.mean_humidity IS NOT NULL) SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, excess_over_all_equipment_avg, difference_from_kept_mean FROM ranked WHERE result_rank <= 10 ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST
